_enforcement_note: block: refuse the tool call and explain. warn: allow but inject the reason as feedback. There is no agent-controlled off mode; policy controls are security boundaries and can only be changed in repository source under review.

destructive._note: Destructive commands are refused outright. They are not blocked because they are forbidden -- they are blocked because they must be run through common/shell_exec.run() with classification='destructive' and confirm_destructive=True, which records the authorization. The hook names that path in its refusal.
destructive._allow_marker_note: Prefixing a command with this marker documents that a human authorized this specific irreversible action. The marker is deliberately noisy so it cannot be added by habit.

secret_echo._note: Refuse commands that would print a credential store straight into the transcript, which is how a secret ends up in an LLM context and in the session log.

ci_log_access._note: The sole agent-facing CI route is ./scripts/prfail --pr <PR_NUMBER>. The collector in .github/workflows/ci-diagnostics.yml publishes a filtered Check Run report bound to the current PR head SHA; all direct Actions data, annotations, logs, artifacts, check results, and legacy PR-comment reads are blocked.
ci_log_access.message: THAPPAR — CI DIAGNOSTIC ACCESS BLOCKED. Use only: ./scripts/prfail --pr <PR_NUMBER>. Direct or alternative diagnostic retrieval is prohibited.
ci_log_access._hard_deny_note: Raw check/log reads are denied before the allowlist. Only the exact ./scripts/prfail --pr positive-decimal command is exempt; selectors and shell wrappers are not implemented.
ci_log_access._allowed_note: Exactly one command is permitted: ./scripts/prfail --pr followed by a positive decimal PR number.
ci_log_access._banned_note: Mirrors common.command_schema.CI_LOG_PATTERNS; tests require the shared classifier and JSON fallback to agree.

local_checks.run_command: DISABLED: GitHub Actions is the sole test/build/check execution path.
local_checks.rule: GitHub Actions is the sole execution path for tests, builds, lint, security scans, workflow validation, and quality gates. The legacy local_checks.py prepare notice reader is retired for agent use. The only permitted diagnostic retrieval command is ./scripts/prfail --pr <PR_NUMBER>, which reads the finalized filtered Check Run report; the run subcommand remains disabled.

_gh_note: CI run data and arbitrary PR-comment reads are blocked. The only permitted diagnostic route is the exact ./scripts/prfail --pr <PR_NUMBER> command; ordinary PR metadata and comment writes remain separately governed.

github_route._note: The GitHub tool contract is code-owned. This section is documentary; it cannot widen a route.

_removed_sections_note: SCR-006: bounded_output, observation_boundary and ci_observability had no consumer; the hooks read config/observation_boundary.json (80-line limits). CI live-watch bans live in ci_log_access and common/command_schema.py.
